LanguageData.TH_Rec1: Call the orbital trader or faction caravan you want from the comms console
LanguageData.TH_Rec2: Pay from any silver in your stores – no orbital beacons
LanguageData.TH_Rec3: Countdown in the alerts; retries and refunds if it can't come
LanguageData.TH_BaseFee_Desc: The basic price for calling a trader.
LanguageData.TH_WealthFee_Desc: A richer colony pays a bit more. 0 = always the same fee.
LanguageData.TH_Delay_Desc: How long a normally called trader takes to arrive.
LanguageData.TH_Express_Desc: How fast an express call arrives.
LanguageData.TH_ExpressMul_Desc: How much more an express call costs.
LanguageData.TH_Cooldown_Desc: How long until you can call the next trader. 0 = any time.
LanguageData.TH_Stay_Desc: You called it – it gives you more time to trade.
LanguageData.TH_Refund_Desc: When the trader can't arrive for two days (another mod, game limits), the fee comes back in a drop pod.
LanguageData.TH_AlreadyCalled: a trader is already on the way
LanguageData.TH_Note: The trader arrives for sure: if it can't come right away it tries again for two days, otherwise the fee comes back. It stays {0} % as long as a normal trader. Trading works as usual through the comms console.
LanguageData.TH_NoSilver: Not enough silver in your stores ({0} needed).
LanguageData.TH_Called: {0} is on the way – arrives in {1}. Paid {2} silver.
LanguageData.TH_FailText: {0} could not reach your colony. Your {1} silver was sent back.
LanguageData.TH_AlertText: The trader you called is on the way.
LanguageData.TH_Arrived: The {1} {0} you called is in orbit now. It stays for {2}. Talk to it from the comms console.
LanguageData.TH_NoComms: No powered comms console – you need one to trade.
LanguageData.TH_NoCaravans: No friendly faction sends caravans now.
LanguageData.TH_KindShip: Trade ship in orbit – trade from the comms console.
LanguageData.TH_KindCaravan: Caravan – walks in to your colony and trades in person.
LanguageData.TH_NoteCaravan: The caravan comes surely: if it can't come at once (danger on the map, the faction turned hostile), it tries again for two days, otherwise the fee is sent back.
LanguageData.TH_CaravanMul_Desc: A caravan walks in and is cheaper than a trade ship.
LanguageData.TH_NoneHere: No trader here. Mark traders with the star to see them in Favorites.
LanguageData.TH_FavTip: Favorite – shown first and in Favorites
LanguageData.TH_Buys: Would buy from your stores: ≈ {0} silver
LanguageData.TH_BuysNothing: Nothing in your stores this trader buys.
LanguageData.TH_BuysNote: An estimate: traders pay about half the market value; your negotiator's skill changes it.
LanguageData.TH_Request_Desc: The trader brings extra goods of this kind worth about {0} silver, on top of the usual stock. You still pay for the goods when you buy them – the extra fee is for bringing them.
LanguageData.TH_WarnDanger: Enemies are on the map right now – the trader may arrive in the middle of a fight.
LanguageData.TH_WarnGoodwill: Relations with this faction are bad.
LanguageData.TH_ReqValue_Desc: How much extra goods a special order brings.
LanguageData.TH_ReqFee: Special order costs {0} % of the goods' value
LanguageData.TH_ReqFee_Desc: The fee for bringing the extra goods (they are still paid when bought).
LanguageData.TH_Loyalty_Desc: Every 5 calls make every next call 5 % cheaper, at most 20 %.
